To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) consumer perception of CSR has a positive effect on corporate brand trust and a negative effect on corporate hypocrisy; 2) consumer perception of corporate hypocrisy has a negative effect on consumer perception of corporate reputation and corporate brand trust; and 3) consumer perception of reputation has a positive effect of consumer perception of corporate brand trust.

corporate brand trust plays an important role in the relationships between consumer perception of a company’s CSR and its reputation and between consumer perception of the CSR and the perceived hypocrisy of a company.
corporate brand trust is an important mediating factor that links consumer perception of CSR with corporate reputation and corporate hypocrisy.
